notes.title: Our Legacy Collection comes to Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]The Original SoulGame Collection is here![/h1]

I'm very happy to announce that the original [i][b]Swords & Souls[/b][/i] game is coming to Steam! And it's not coming alone, but packed with all 5 SoulGame classic Flash games, including the [b][i]Rogue Soul[/i][/b] series of course, [b][i]The Soul Driver[/i][/b] and [b][i]The Gentleman[/i][/b]. 

[h3]👇[b]Wishlist now[/b]👇 to support us and be notified on launch![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3189440/Swords__Souls_Legacy_Collection

[list]
[*] Five full-feature games in one to retrace SoulGame history from 2011 to 2015!
[*] FHD support allowing to play in fullscreen, and for Rogue Soul 1 & 2 and The Soul Driver specifically, borders have been widened to further improve the gameplay experience! 
[*] Better performances on average than the Web versions
[*] An exclusive set of new skins I cooked for Rogue Soul 2
[*] Steam Achievements including the best challenges from all five games 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32336194/c8cf00e8e21f7423e37ee7c0ca192c71a3992cb3.gif[/img]

See you around in game!

[h3][i]Argl & Kuho[/i][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32336194/460a3a81a31a18a4293e93f1ed6f6ae78152e862.png[/img]

notes.title: Steam Deck Update
notes.content:
After taking a break to recover from launch, we focused on making the game [b]Verified on Steam Deck[/b], while making it more fluid and fix some major issues.
[list]
[*] We rebuilt all UI components that were poorly readable on SteamDeck. Which makes UI more user friendly and accessible for Steam Deck and PC as well.
[*] We did a final pass on optimization to remove nasty lag spikes and FPS drops. Gameplay on PC is more fluid than ever in epic fights which is especially crucial on SteamDeck.
[*] We changed the Steam API to make sure Achievements would work for MacOs user as well. Sorry about that, you should be able to redeem your Achievements if you have a save file around (if not you can find one in the forums about lost save).
[/list]
Smaller changes :
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where unique keys were carried over to new games
[*] Fixed an issue that caused lag and freeze after reloading the game several times. (Many thanks to xcvdgb and Zookster on discord)
[*] Added the lowest difficulty chosen on the Save slot so you know which Achievement you are eligible to
[*] Made it easier to skip intro (just press Enter or Escape, or Start on gamepad)
[/list]
[i]Special thanks to our friend and consultant Maxime who helped us a lot during all this process <3[/i]

[h2]Change logs v1.03[/h2]

[b]IMPORTANT CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]MAP DETECTION SYSTEM:[/b] map icon now discreetly "beep" and shake as you get closer to a missing map piece. We hope this would alleviate the frustration of not finding the missing maps.
[*] [b]SOFTLOCK ISSUES:[/b] All issues linked to being softlock by a boss, a fight, a torch or a button, etc. should be fixed retroactively. 
[*] [b]PARKOUR/RACES BALANCING:[/b]Starting a race now also restores your energy. Improved races timing that felt odly balanced and were particularly difficult to beat with Keyboard and mouse setups. 
[/list]
[b]SMALLER CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a map marker to clarify the main path to access the second Dungeon
[*]Improved lighthouse puzzle
[*]Fixed supershot camera movement not being affected by screenshake settings
[*]Scarab can't get stuck behind the torch in Desert Temple anymore
[*]French localization dialogs improved
[*]Fixed out of bound visual issue in dungeon 2
[/list]

[url=https://www.makeship.com/products/minishoot][b]Don't forget to get your Minishoot' plushie ^^[/b][/url]

notes.title: Minipatch #3 - Get back your Achievement!
notes.content:
[h2]Hard Achievement Issue[/h2]
I fixed another bug that prevented the achievement obtention. This was due to issues regarding the initialization of both difficulty pop up AND options menu, and how Unity toggle buttons works.

[b][i]The issue should now be fixed for all NEW playthroughs.[/i][/b]

For current playthrough, you can still [b]retrieve your missing achievements.[/b] (if you have already completed the game) by clicking this button:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609424/d13e5a8d3c634db9505025895ee90add0aa2bbdd.png[/img]
I'll remove the button in a couple of weeks after everyone got the chance to get their achievements back.

[h3]Minor fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Slightly nerfed some bullet from the last pattern of the third boss
[*]Adjusted the map emplacement of a hole in the abyss that didn't match the real location
[*]Fixed the issue with Map key input displaying "semi-colon"
[*]Fixed rare issue where main menu became invisible
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40609424/ed23e9ad3b48a4e8304e0b8cce53a2451faf0223.png[/img]
[i]Argl[/i]

notes.title: Minipatch #2 - Auto-Backup Save
notes.content:
Some of you reported losing their save file after random crashes which is really the worst. I tried to come up with a good solution. I hope this changes will prevent most save file issue! 
[h3]Save issue fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]The game now creates a backup save every 2 minutes instead of once upon loading.[/b]
[*][b]If you main save file is lost or corrupted, the game will automatically try to load the existing backup and let you know your file has been restored.[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Slightly increase XP gain against bigger enemies
[*]Added remapable button for the Map
[*](end game spoiler) [spoiler]Made sure you couldn't go past the Unchosen in the snow area[/spoiler]
[/list]

notes.title: Minipatch #1 - Covfefe Jar
notes.content:
First patch is here! Thank you all for your precious feedback and especially to Moojuiceman for the help with the achievement issue. 

I fixed all that was fast and safe to fix, will get back to work asap to fix the rest! 
 
[h2]Important[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed softlock at the final boss, being stuck behind the crystal barrier. It will now re-open if needed.
[*]Fixed Arena achievement being awarded one arena too soon.
[*]Fixed an issue where you could finish the game in Advanced without getting the achievement. Unfortunately this in not retroactive as I have no way to know who picked what difficulty due to the bug itself. I apologize for your lost efforts. If you still care to get the achievement, I’d suggest waiting for a future content update, and redo the game in Advanced on such occasion. Really sorry about this annoying issue :'( 
[/list]
[h2]Minor[/h2]
[list]
[*]Removed confusing map icon/ping and fixed a cave position
[*]Fixed some typoes
[*]Lowered Teleport module price
[*]Removed a softlocking gap in dungeon 1
[*]Removed the annoying crackling looping sound
[*]Added the covfefe jar
[/list]
